THE STORY BEHIND THE SWEETNESS

A home kitchen.
A generous heart.

A fictional brand story, created for this portfolio concept.

Inspired by the way Dubai gathers.

In the imagined Sift & Saffron kitchen, baking begins with an occasion: a birthday candle, a new arrival, or friends coming over after a long week.

The fictional founder, Mariam, builds her recipes around familiar flavours and careful finishing — soft vanilla sponge, deep chocolate, a little citrus and buttercream piped by hand.

The idea is simple: beautiful bakes that feel personal, with clear prices and a friendly conversation before every order.

A note on this project

Sift & Saffron is an original fictional identity designed as a web-development portfolio piece. It is not a trading bakery or a paying client. All products, prices and operating policies are illustrative.
